threadTitle: Specify the native icon manifest and conversion checks

item.text:
$ /bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,copy
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/tmp/conclave-overhaul/wp1-icons/manifest-contract');p=out/'proposed-manifest.json';d=json.loads(p.read_text())
for c in d['concepts']:
 if c['id']=='reactions':c['references'].append({'document':'S30','line':762})
 for v in c['android_variants']:
  key=(c['id'],v['state'])
  values={('microphone','on'):'On',('microphone','muted'):'Muted',('camera','on'):'On',('camera','off'):'Off',('raise_hand','lowered'):'Not raised (Android); absent (iOS)',('raise_hand','raised'):'Raised',('captions','off'):'Off',('captions','on'):'On',('lock_meeting','locked'):'On',('lock_meeting','unlocked'):'Off',('reactions','closed'):'Closed',('reactions','open'):'Open',('share_screen','idle'):None,('share_screen','sharing_stop_action'):'Sharing',('copy_link','copied'):None}
  if key in values:v['accessibility']['value']=values[key]
 if c['id']=='share_screen':
  sharing=next(v for v in c['android_variants'] if v['state']=='sharing_stop_action');sharing['state']='sharing_toggle'
  action=copy.deepcopy(sharing);action['state']='stop_sharing_action';action['accessibility']={'label':'Stop sharing','value':None,'role':'button','icon_exposure':'decorative_in_labeled_owner'};c['android_variants'].append(action)
 if c['id']=='reactions':
  for v in c['android_variants']:v['references'].append({'document':'S30','line':762})
d['counts']['android_context_bindings']=sum(len(c['android_variants']) for c in d['concepts'])
p.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n')
f=out/'implementation-brief.md';f.write_text(f.read_text().replace('57 contextual Android bindings','58 contextual Android bindings'))
lines=['# Decision list and scope boundaries','',
'This is a concrete proposal for parent review, not new canonical requirements. No unresolved canonical contradiction remains in this bounded selection. Parent authority and F00 common mappings settle stale feature snippets; none of the historical reconciliation is reopened.','',
'## Decisions','']
for x in d['decisions']:lines+=['- **'+x['id']+'** — '+x['summary']]
lines+=['','"'`D01–D07` distinguish recommendations from directly numbered or derived F00 requirements on every binding. D05 is a concrete application of the existing toggle rule, not a new fill rule. Group open fill, filled presenting badge, and filled pinned badge are the three proposed additions above the 51-pair lower bound. They may be removed only by an explicit revised proposal with corresponding counts/consumers changed.'"','',
'**Minimal state policy:** More is an ordinary menu invoker whose FILL 0 artwork stays unchanged while open (its fills have identical accepted bytes). Transcript, Settings, Activities, Q&A and layout-picker Spotlight remain single-fill actions; no open-state glyph transition is specified for them. A switch row already conveys state through its switch; its decorative leading "'`image`, `add_reaction`, policy `mic_off` etc reuse the selected core image and do not create a second fill. Participants open is an explicit recommendation, not claimed as a feature-mandated numeric fill. Audio route cycling changes kind and route value, not binary filled/unfilled state.'"','',
'## All 37 unspecified-fill names','',
'F00 explicitly numbers fills for the other 11 names (14 pairs). This table covers every base whose numeric fill is absent from the core row; the full manifest preserves per-binding status and provenance.','',
'| Name | Proposed FILL | Decision / rationale |','|---|---|---|']
for v in d['unspecified_fill_inventory']:lines.append('| "'`'"'+v['name']+'"'` | '"'+', '.join(map(str,v['selected_fills']))+' | '+v['decision_id']+': '+v['rationale']+' |')
lines+=['','## Explicit SF and semantic context decisions','',
'- Keep all **46 exact core literals**. Apply no generic "'`.fill` expansion. F00 exact rows take precedence over its broad filled-bar/outline-list guidance where an explicit name is provided.'"',
'- Include **"'`mic.slash`, `video.slash`** for host mute/camera-off menu actions (S20:837–838; S50:711–712), **`pin.fill`** for pinned status (S20:796; S50:692), and **`rectangle.inset.filled.on.rectangle`** for presenting status (S20:800; S50:694). Those distinct explicit menu/badge contexts do not replace the core control glyph. All four are marked as outside the preflight availability proof.'"',
'- Copied confirmation reuses "'`checkmark`/`check` without creating a new concept or an extra vector. The control label remains Copy link; the consumer announces the copied event according to its feature. Host badge merges “host” into the row; Host controls is a separate labeled action using the same Android artwork.'"',
'- Stable Share screen toggle label + Sharing value and separate Stop sharing action label both use the selected active artwork. Mic/Camera/Hand/Caption/Lock states have explicit values in the manifest; Reactions has Open/Closed (S30:762). Lock in the host menu is Checkbox (S50:908), not blindly forced into a Switch. Route rows use their own route names/RadioButton selection semantics, while the invoker stays Audio output/Button.',
'- Core labels are sentence case even if visible iOS menu text is title case. Context labels such as Send question, Leave webinar, Clear search, Remove photo, Cancel private message, Close {title}, Back to call and Admit {name} are caller-owned localization, never vector names. The bounded gallery does not adopt their feature behavior.',
'', '## Deferred feature artwork and snippets', '',
'These are deliberate scope exclusions, not unresolved decisions or hidden fallback aliases. The next feature owner must add an explicit independently checked manifest entry before using artwork outside the selected core. This contract does not claim all eight specs are fully covered.', '',
'| Context | Disposition |', '|---|---|',
'| iOS custom route label ("'`speaker.wave.2.fill`, `iphone`, AirPods-specific names, `headphones`, `cable.connector`, `car.fill`, `airplayaudio`, `hearingdevice.ear`; S30:895–905) | Defer the feature-specific route-display adapter. The core iOS entry remains system AVRoutePickerView; no custom route or Bluetooth inference in this gallery. |'"',
'| Android extended routes ("'`directions_car`, `usb`, `hearing`, `cast`; S10:495, S30:954–960) | Outside the accepted 48 names; no substitution or synthetic path. |'"',
'| iOS input selector "'`mic`, recent-meeting `video`, contextual `ellipsis.circle` (S10:496,669,512) | Input-device, recent-meeting and ellipsis-in-circle contexts are feature additions, not required core mic/camera/More state variants. Defer. |'"',
'| Lower-hand action "'`hand.raised.slash` / `hand.raised.slash.fill`, waiting-menu `checkmark.circle`, Make-host `crown`, private-message `bubble.left` (S30:513; S50:680,707–717) | Distinct feature actions require explicit entries on adoption. Core hand toggle remains hand.raised/hand.raised.fill and front_hand 0/1; no unaccepted do_not_touch input is introduced. |'"',
'| Composite composer "'`arrow.up`, staged-image `xmark.circle.fill`, privacy `lock` / `lock.slash`, error/removal illustration variants (S40:693–696,731,768–794; S60:853; S10:499–503) | Do not silently substitute these for the core Send/Close/Lock/error/removal literals. Defer named context additions/approved exceptions to the feature owner. |'"',
'| Alternate common snippets such as Transcript "'`subtitles`, Copy Link `link`, stop-share `rectangle.slash`, GIF `face.smiling`, Photo `photo.on.rectangle` | F00:49 and §11.3 own common-control mapping. Selected core remains description/text.quote, content_copy/doc.on.doc, cancel_presentation/rectangle.on.rectangle.slash, gif_box/photo.on.rectangle, image/photo. No alias or reopened blocker. |'"',
'| Games, layout choices, network illustrations, wordmark and noncore controls | Separate verified inputs/explicit entries before feature compilation. Small badges or typography do not require a new optical-size source. |',
'', '## Independent read-only audit', '',
'One delegated research audit independently confirmed the 36/48/46 inventory, 14 numbered pairs/11 bases, all 37 unspecified-fill bases, Back **and Send** mirroring, distinct SF menu/badge contexts, caller-owned semantics and no new canonical-name contradiction. It reported no additional explicit numeric Android core fill pair from feature contexts. Its findings informed D02–D09 and the deferred feature inventory; it did not validate this manifest or accept implementation. Task ID: "'`node:delegated-task:command%3Amcp%3Aac153577-8735-4efc-b269-bccb7597afd1%3Adelegate-task%3Awp1-icon-contract-context-audit-20261023-r1`. No child writes were authorized.'"',
'', '## Limits and next ownership', '',
'[validation.json](validation.json) is document/input consistency evidence only. The [brief](implementation-brief.md) specifies future semantic geometry fixtures and independent SVG/native pixel checks separately from regeneration drift. No normalization, renderer, generated source, build, runtime or accessibility acceptance exists. SF availability is limited to the existing preflight evidence; additional names and API/minimum-OS paths remain open verification gates.',
'', 'Feedback/panels retains exclusive implementation ownership. After its acceptance, the icon owner re-reads the final tree/API and implements this reviewed finite contract. Adaptive inspector/stage retention follows separately through the same coordinator; no second coordinator is proposed. Canonical and stable historical files remain parent-owned and unchanged by this lane.','']
(out/'decisions.md').write_text('\\n'.join(lines))
PY
python3 -B /tmp/conclave-overhaul/wp1-icons/manifest-contract/validate-contract.py > /tmp/conclave-overhaul/wp1-icons/manifest-contract/validation.json"
